reversal_summary: The matched-pair reanalysis confirmed the V3 pilot's null was genuine, then derived a dilution formula (independently re-derived from first principles by both reviewers, confirmed correct) projecting the V3 single-block injection point would need ~4.33e8 trials -- but the Red Team showed this figure rests on an approximation the campaign's own data already contradicts, and, more importantly, computed that the SAME formula applied to a global (V1-class, all-56-block) injection projects a required T of ~1.38e5 -- cheaper than the specification's own baseline T_req. This reverses the campaign's direction away from further single-block refinement and toward a global-injection pilot. A Coordinator overclaim ('astronomically infeasible') from this batch's review briefing was caught before entering any permanent record and is retracted.
